SELECT name, salary,
       CASE
         WHEN salary >= 100000 THEN 'High'
         WHEN salary >= 50000 THEN 'Medium'
         ELSE 'Low'
       END as level
FROM employees;

SELECT product_name,
       price,
       CASE
         WHEN stock = 0 THEN 'Out of Stock'
         WHEN stock < 10 THEN 'Low Stock'
         ELSE 'In Stock'
       END as availability
FROM products
ORDER BY stock ASC;

SELECT name,
       COALESCE(phone, email, 'No Contact') as contact
FROM users
ORDER BY name;

SELECT order_id,
       total,
       CASE
         WHEN total >= 100 THEN total * 0.1
         WHEN total >= 50 THEN total * 0.05
         ELSE 0
       END as discount,
       total - CASE
         WHEN total >= 100 THEN total * 0.1
         WHEN total >= 50 THEN total * 0.05
         ELSE 0
       END as final_price
FROM orders;

SELECT u.name,
       CASE
         WHEN COUNT(o.id) >= 10 THEN 'VIP'
         WHEN COUNT(o.id) >= 5 THEN 'Regular'
         ELSE 'New'
       END as customer_type
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
GROUP BY u.id, u.name;

SELECT name,
       score,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) as rank,
       CASE
         WHEN score >= 90 THEN 'A'
         WHEN score >= 80 THEN 'B'
         WHEN score >= 70 THEN 'C'
         ELSE 'D'
       END as grade
FROM students;

SELECT product_name,
       price,
       CASE
         WHEN price > AVG(price) OVER () THEN 'Above Average'
         WHEN price = AVG(price) OVER () THEN 'Average'
         ELSE 'Below Average'
       END as price_category
FROM products;

SELECT name,
       IFNULL(phone, 'N/A') as phone,
       IFNULL(email, 'N/A') as email
FROM contacts;

SELECT order_id,
       created_at,
       CASE
         WHEN DATEDIFF(NOW(), created_at) <= 1 THEN 'Today'
         WHEN DATEDIFF(NOW(), created_at) <= 7 THEN 'This Week'
         WHEN DATEDIFF(NOW(), created_at) <= 30 THEN 'This Month'
         ELSE 'Older'
       END as time_category
FROM orders;

SELECT name,
       CASE gender
         WHEN 'M' THEN 'Male'
         WHEN 'F' THEN 'Female'
         ELSE 'Other'
       END as gender_display
FROM users;

SELECT u.name,
       CASE
         WHEN MAX(o.total) >= 1000 THEN 'Premium'
         WHEN MAX(o.total) >= 100 THEN 'Standard'
         WHEN COUNT(o.id) > 0 THEN 'Basic'
         ELSE 'No Orders'
       END as tier
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id
GROUP BY u.id, u.name;

SELECT name,
       CASE
         WHEN age < 13 THEN 'Child'
         WHEN age < 18 THEN 'Teen'
         WHEN age < 65 THEN 'Adult'
         ELSE 'Senior'
       END as age_group,
       COUNT(*) as count
FROM users
GROUP BY age_group
ORDER BY age_group;

SELECT product_name,
       price,
       CASE
         WHEN price < 10 THEN 'Budget'
         WHEN price < 50 THEN 'Mid-range'
         WHEN price < 200 THEN 'Premium'
         ELSE 'Luxury'
       END as category,
       CASE
         WHEN stock = 0 THEN '🔴'
         WHEN stock < 5 THEN '🟡'
         ELSE '🟢'
       END as stock_indicator
FROM products
ORDER BY price;
